name: Geyser of Acid
body:
School conjuration (creation) [acid]; Level magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a drop of acid)

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Area 10-ft. radius, 40-ft. high cylinder

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

You cause a geyser of hissing acid to erupt from the point you designate. A creature at the center of the cylinder takes 1d8 points of acid damage per caster level (maximum 20d8). Each other creature within the cylinder takes 1d6 acid damage per 2 caster levels you possess (maximum 10d6). Creatures in a further 10-foot radius of the area take 1d6 acid damage.
